title_zh: 旅行者 1 号距地球达一光日，信号单程需 24 小时
content_zh:
按 NASA 公布的轨道测算，旅行者 1 号在美国太平洋时间 11 月 18 日 2:16:07，即北京时间 18:16:07，与地球的距离达到一个光日，约 259 亿公里。它成为首个人类制造的、抵达这一距离的物体。

一个光日是光在真空中一天走过的距离。旅行者 1 号的无线电信号以光速传播，单程抵达地球约需 24 小时；地面发出指令并等待探测器回应，通信往返便约为两天。

从 1977 年发射至今，这段旅程已持续 49 年。NASA 表示，旅行者 1 号与旅行者 2 号仍是仅有的两艘在日球层之外运行的探测器，那里位于太阳风与太阳磁场形成的保护范围之外。NASA 还为这次里程碑发起「Shine Bright for Voyager’s Light-Day」活动，邀请公众用手机、手电筒和建筑灯光向深空致意。
title_en: Voyager 1 Reaches Historic Milestone: Now One Light-Day Away from Earth
content_en:
NASA's Voyager 1 probe has officially reached a monumental distance of one light-day from Earth—roughly 25.9 billion kilometers away. This achievement makes it the first human-made object in history to venture this far into deep space.

At this staggering distance, radio signals traveling at the speed of light take about 24 hours to reach Earth. A complete round-trip communication cycle—sending a command from Earth and receiving a response—now takes nearly two full days.

Launched in 1977, Voyager 1 and its twin Voyager 2 remain the only spacecraft operating beyond the heliosphere, outside the protective boundary formed by the solar wind and magnetic fields. To celebrate the milestone, NASA launched the "Shine Bright for Voyager’s Light-Day" campaign, inviting the public to shine lights toward deep space in tribute.

title_zh: 网易 UU 远程将上线付费会员，基础远控继续免费
content_zh:
网易 UU 远程宣布，12 月 1 日推出 VIP、SVIP 增值服务，基础远程控制继续免费，不限连接次数与时长、不排队、无广告。

免费版保留 1080P、30 帧画质，文件传输、远程开机、麦克风直连、隐私屏、端口映射及终端工具等功能。VIP 增加最高 4K、144 帧、500Mbps 串流，支持 HDR、多通道中转、多屏与虚拟屏、自定义隐私屏等；SVIP 在此基础上提供全球远控节点。

VIP 连续包月为 24 元，单月购买为 30 元，年卡为 238 元；SVIP 连续包月为 88 元，单月购买为 98 元，年卡为 758 元。12 月 1 日服务上线前注册的老用户，可在客户端消息中心领取年卡五折优惠，VIP 折后约合每月 9.9 元。
title_en: NetEase UU Remote to Introduce Paid VIP Tiers While Keeping Basic Features Free
content_en:
NetEase UU Remote has announced the launch of new VIP and SVIP subscription tiers starting December 1. Despite the introduction of paid tiers, the core remote control service will remain completely free, offering ad-free access with no connection limits or queueing.

The free tier continues to offer 1080p resolution at 30 fps, along with essential features such as file transfer, remote wake-on-LAN, microphone passthrough, privacy screen, and port mapping.

For power users, the VIP tier unlocks up to 4K resolution at 144 fps, 500Mbps streaming, HDR support, and virtual multi-screen capabilities, starting at 24 RMB per month for auto-renewing subscriptions. The SVIP tier adds global remote control nodes. Existing users registered before December 1 can claim a 50% discount on annual passes within the app.

title_zh: 樊路远辞任阿里大麦娱乐 CEO，徐宏接任董事会主席
content_zh:
大麦娱乐于 11 月 16 日公告，樊路远因专注发展个人事业，辞任执行董事、董事会主席及首席执行官，同时退出执行委员会、提名委员会及薪酬委员会。

阿里巴巴集团首席财务官徐宏获委任为大麦娱乐非执行董事及董事会主席，沈严获委任为执行董事及联席总裁。徐宏曾担任阿里影业非执行董事；沈严于 2016 年加入阿里巴巴，今年 3 月接掌大麦演出业务。

樊路远于 2007 年加入支付宝，后来进入阿里影业及大文娱管理层。大麦娱乐前身为阿里影业，目前业务包括影视内容、现场演出、IP 授权及票务服务。
title_en: Fan Luyuan Steps Down as Damai Entertainment CEO; Alibaba CFO Toby Xu Named Board Chair
content_en:
Damai Entertainment announced that Fan Luyuan has resigned from his positions as Executive Director, Chairman of the Board, and CEO to focus on personal career endeavors. He has also stepped down from the executive, nomination, and remuneration committees.

Following his departure, Alibaba Group CFO Toby Xu (Xu Hong) has been appointed as Non-Executive Director and Board Chairman. Meanwhile, Shen Yan, who joined Alibaba in 2016 and took charge of Damai's live performance sector earlier this year, has been named Executive Director and Co-President.

Fan originally joined Alipay in 2007 before moving into executive roles across Ali Pictures and Alibaba's Digital Media and Entertainment Group. Formerly known as Ali Pictures, Damai Entertainment encompasses film content, live performances, IP licensing, and ticketing services.

title_zh: 腾讯大幅削减元宝投入，微信小微日活达 3000 万
content_zh:
腾讯总裁刘炽平在 11 月 18 日第三季度业绩会上确认，元宝「没有我们预期的那么成功」，腾讯已大幅减少对元宝的支出，产品重心从扩大用户规模转回能力建设，近期推出了 AI 搜索功能。

据华尔街见闻整理的业绩会问答，刘炽平表示，微信内置 AI 助手小微正在扩大测试，已覆盖朋友圈、公众号、视频号等超过 30 个触点，日活跃用户达到 3000 万。小微采用轻量模型，公司预计，即使向全部微信用户开放，其季度成本也会低于今年年初元宝的季度成本。

企业端的 WorkBuddy 日活已超过 1000 万，每日消耗超过 100 万亿 token。腾讯称，自 6 月推出企业版以来，中国百强企业中已有 60% 成为其客户。刘炽平将小微的近期变现机会放在微信现有的广告和交易收入上，后续能力则随小程序及其他生态连接逐步扩展。
title_en: Tencent Scales Back Yuanbao AI Spending as WeChat's Xiaowei Hits 30 Million DAU
content_en:
Tencent has significantly scaled back investment in its standalone AI app Yuanbao after acknowledging it fell short of expectations. Speaking at the company’s Q3 earnings call on November 18, Tencent President Martin Lau stated that the team has pivoted from driving user scale back to core capability building, which recently included the launch of an AI search feature.

Meanwhile, WeChat's built-in AI assistant, Xiaowei, is gaining traction. Currently being tested across over 30 touchpoints within the ecosystem—such as Moments, Official Accounts, and Channels—Xiaowei has reached 30 million daily active users (DAUs). Powered by lightweight models, its quarterly operational costs are expected to remain below Yuanbao’s early 2024 levels, even if expanded to all WeChat users.

On the enterprise front, Tencent's WorkBuddy assistant surpassed 10 million DAUs, consuming over 100 trillion tokens daily. Since its June launch, 60% of China's top 100 enterprises have adopted the service. Tencent plans to monetize Xiaowei initially through WeChat’s existing advertising and transaction ecosystem before expanding into mini-programs and broader integrations.

title_zh: 微软 To Do 将于明年 6 月停用，现有任务不会自动迁移
content_zh:
微软在官方支持页面宣布，Microsoft To Do 应用将于 2027 年 6 月 30 日停用，涵盖网页版及 Windows、Mac、iOS、Android 客户端，工作、学校和个人账户均受影响。

工作或学校账户将转向 Microsoft Planner 管理个人工作任务，新版「My tasks」体验从今年 12 月开始推送。新建私人任务会存入 Planner 的私人计划，现有 To Do 任务和清单不会迁移；这些旧任务在 Planner 中可查看、管理至停用日。

个人 Microsoft 账户，包括 Microsoft 365 个人版和家庭版用户，无法使用这一 Planner 替代方案，需要另选任务管理应用。微软将于停用前提供导出工具，但导出文件不等同于可直接导入 Planner。

底层 To Do 服务、API 和同步支持会在后续另行停用，具体时间将单独公布。
title_en: Microsoft to Retire To Do App in June 2027 Without Automatic Data Migration
content_en:
Microsoft has announced on its official support page that it will retire the Microsoft To Do application on June 30, 2027. The shutdown will affect web, Windows, Mac, iOS, and Android clients across work, school, and personal accounts.

For work and school account holders, personal task management will transition to Microsoft Planner, featuring a new "My tasks" experience rolling out starting this December. While new private tasks will automatically save to Planner's private plans, existing To Do tasks and lists will not be automatically migrated. Users will, however, be able to view and manage these legacy tasks within Planner until the retirement date.

Personal account holders, including Microsoft 365 Personal and Family subscribers, will not have access to Planner as a replacement and will need to transition to third-party alternatives. Microsoft plans to release an export tool prior to the shutdown, though exported files cannot be directly imported into Planner. Sunset timelines for underlying APIs and sync services will be announced separately.

title_zh: 快手第三季度转亏，预计四季度收入和盈利继续承压
content_zh:
快手 11 月 19 日公布第三季度业绩，收入为 315.92 亿元；归母净亏损 9.61 亿元，上年同期为盈利。剔除股份薪酬、投资公允价值变动等项目后，经调整净利润为 7.9 亿元。公司预计，四季度收入和盈利能力可能继续承压，可灵 AI 及整体 AI 战略的持续投入将增加短期成本。

业务方面，线上营销服务收入约 179 亿元，同比下降 11.1%，公司将其主要归因于消费环境变化及电商竞争加剧；直播收入约 78 亿元，同比下降 19%；其他服务收入约 60 亿元，同比增长 1.5%，游戏和可灵 AI 增长部分抵消了电商收入下降。第三季度毛利率为 48.2%，低于上年同期的 54.7%。

快手应用平均日活跃用户为 4.173 亿，平均月活跃用户为 8.185 亿。公司称，可灵 AI 已在第三季度公布 Kling 4.0，并向部分用户开放 Flash 版本；快手万擎营业收入环比增长近 90%。

前三季度，快手收入为 1008.43 亿元，归母净利润为 50.88 亿元。同期分红和股份回购合计超过 58 亿港元。公司表示，将加强核心业务成本管控和效率提升，并继续执行资本回报举措。
title_en: Kuaishou Swings to Q3 Net Loss Amid Rising AI Costs and E-Commerce Competition
content_en:
Kuaishou reported a net loss of 961 million yuan for the third quarter, swinging from a profit a year earlier despite generating 31.592 billion yuan in revenue. On an adjusted basis, net profit reached 790 million yuan. The short-video platform warned that fourth-quarter revenue and profitability will likely remain under pressure due to macroeconomic shifts, aggressive e-commerce competition, and ongoing investments in its Kling AI initiative.

Revenue across core segments showed weakness. Online marketing services revenue dropped 11.1% year-over-year to 17.9 billion yuan, while live-streaming revenue fell 19% to 7.8 billion yuan. Other services grew 1.5% to 6 billion yuan, supported by growth in gaming and Kling AI that partially offset e-commerce declines. Overall gross margin narrowed to 48.2%, down from 54.7% in the same period last year.

Despite financial headwinds, user metrics remained solid, with daily active users reaching 417.3 million and monthly active users climbing to 818.5 million. Kuaishou highlighted progress in its AI operations, including the release of Kling 4.0 and a nearly 90% quarter-over-quarter revenue increase for its marketing engine, Wanqing. Over the first nine months, Kuaishou generated 100.84 billion yuan in total revenue and returned over HK$5.8 billion to shareholders via buybacks and dividends.

title_zh: DeepSeek 完成股权变更，腾讯、宁德时代等进入持股平台
content_zh:
据《科创板日报》报道，DeepSeek 运营主体杭州深度求索近日完成工商变更，新增股东杭州程砚企业管理咨询合伙企业。杭州程砚同期新增 31 名合伙人，腾讯、宁德时代、中国移动、中国电信、小红书、vivo 等产业方，以及多家投资机构出现在名单中。

腾讯旗下上海珩岫与宁德时代相关基金，对杭州程砚的出资比例均为 9.5653%；中国移动旗下中移投资、中信证券投资的出资比例均为 7.6522%。网易、美团关联主体、美的及兆易创新等也通过该平台参与。

梁文锋已退出杭州程砚的直接合伙人名单，但仍通过持股 99% 的杭州程策担任执行事务合伙人。报道援引接近交易人士称，上轮参与的部分机构在本轮享有优先认购额度，DeepSeek 也对出资方进行审核筛选。
title_en: DeepSeek Restructures Shareholding Platform, Attracting Tech Giants and Strategic Investors
content_en:
Hangzhou DeepSeek, the operating entity behind the prominent AI startup, has recently completed a major equity restructuring. A key holding entity, Hangzhou ChengYan Enterprise Management Partnership, added 31 new partners, bringing in major tech and industrial players including Tencent, CATL, China Mobile, China Telecom, Xiaohongshu, vivo, NetEase, Meituan affiliates, Midea, and GigaDevice.

Under the updated structure, Tencent-affiliated Shanghai Hengxiu and a fund backed by CATL each hold a 9.5653% stake in ChengYan. Investment arms of China Mobile and CITIC Securities each hold 7.6522%. DeepSeek founder Liang Wenfeng stepped down as a direct partner in ChengYan but maintains executive control via Hangzhou ChengCe, an entity in which he holds a 99% stake.

According to sources close to the transaction, DeepSeek conducted a strict screening process for incoming investors, granting priority subscription quotas to select participants from previous funding rounds.

title_zh: 阿里巴巴季度净利润增长 207%，营收达 2715.19 亿元
content_zh:
据界面新闻报道，阿里巴巴 11 月 19 日公布截至 2026 年 9 月 30 日的季度及上半财年业绩。第二财季营收为 2715.19 亿元人民币，同比增长 10%。

当季经营利润为 291.16 亿元，同比增长 443%；归属于普通股股东的净利润为 645.35 亿元，同比增长 207%。按非 GAAP 口径，净利润为 199.09 亿元，同比增长 92%。

AI 云与算力服务收入为 609.73 亿元，同比增长 53%，其中外部客户收入同比增长 64%，外部经常性收入同比增长 67%；AI 相关产品收入为 179.18 亿元，连续 13 个季度实现三位数同比增长。

当季资本性支出为 504.77 亿元，同比增长 60%。公司称，投入增加涉及算力规模扩张、芯片组件涨价及客户需求。经营活动现金流净额为 156.90 亿元，自由现金流为净流出 344.72 亿元，主要受云基础设施投入增加影响。

据财联社报道，吴泳铭在同日业绩电话会上还表示，阿里已开始使用今年这一代平头哥国产芯片训练下一代模型；明年一季度的新一代芯片将能够支持超大规模模型训练。

阿里面向 2030 年的长期 AI 基础设施规划，将以平头哥国产芯片的供应链计划为基础。吴泳铭称，随着产能爬坡，国产算力占整体算力的比例将持续提升，成为云收入增长的主要引擎；中国近两年的 AI 算力供需仍会尤其紧张。
title_en: Alibaba Reports 207% Net Profit Surge Driven by Rapid AI Cloud Growth
content_en:
Alibaba Group announced its financial results for the quarter ending September 30, posting revenue of RMB 271.52 billion, a 10% year-over-year increase. Operating profit soared 443% to RMB 29.12 billion, while net income attributable to ordinary shareholders surged 207% to RMB 64.54 billion. Non-GAAP net profit rose 92% to RMB 19.91 billion.

The company's AI and cloud business proved to be a primary growth driver. AI Cloud and computing services generated RMB 60.97 billion, up 53% year-over-year, with external customer revenue surging 64%. Revenue from AI-related products reached RMB 17.92 billion, marking the 13th consecutive quarter of triple-digit growth. Capital expenditure jumped 60% to RMB 50.48 billion to support computing expansion, rising chip costs, and booming client demand.

Alibaba CEO Eddie Wu revealed during the earnings call that the company has begun training its next-generation AI models using its proprietary T-Head (PingTouGe) domestic chips. A new generation of chips scheduled for early next year will support ultra-large-scale model training, laying the foundation for Alibaba's 2030 AI infrastructure strategy as domestic computing capacity becomes the core engine for cloud growth.

title_zh: 拼多多季度营收持平，广告增长与交易服务下滑相抵
content_zh:
拼多多集团 11 月 19 日公布第三季度未经审计业绩：营收为 1083 亿元人民币，与去年同期基本持平。

两项主要业务走势相反：线上营销服务及其他收入为 598 亿元，同比增长 12%；交易服务收入为 485 亿元，同比下降 12%。公司表示，将继续投资供应链能力，为商家开发产品、触达消费者提供支持，全球业务也在适应贸易和监管环境变化。

当季归属于普通股股东的净利润为 295 亿元，去年同期为 293 亿元；非 GAAP 净利润为 310 亿元，去年同期为 314 亿元。经营活动现金流净额为 430 亿元，去年同期为 457 亿元；截至 9 月末，现金、现金等价物及短期投资合计 4554 亿元。
title_en: PDD Holdings Posts Flat Q3 Revenue as Ad Growth Offsets Transaction Decline
content_en:
PDD Holdings reported third-quarter revenue of RMB 108.3 billion, remaining virtually flat compared to the same period last year. Performance diverged across its two core segments: online marketing services revenue grew 12% year-over-year to RMB 59.8 billion, offsetting a 12% decline in transaction services revenue, which stood at RMB 48.5 billion.

Net profit attributable to ordinary shareholders reached RMB 29.5 billion, slightly up from RMB 29.3 billion a year earlier, while non-GAAP net profit came in at RMB 31.0 billion. Net operating cash flow was RMB 43.0 billion, and total cash, cash equivalents, and short-term investments stood at RMB 455.4 billion at the end of September.

PDD stated that it will continue investing in its supply chain capabilities to better empower merchants and expand consumer reach. The company also emphasized its focus on adapting its global operations to an evolving trade and regulatory landscape.

title_zh: 英特尔签下首个 18A-P 外部客户
content_zh:
英特尔 CEO 陈立武在美国得州奥斯汀的 TomorrowX 峰会上表示，公司已为 18A 芯片制造工艺签下首个外部客户。英特尔技术负责人 Pushkar Ranade 随后澄清，客户采用的是 18A-P 工艺，该节点已于今年 6 月进入风险生产阶段。

据 CNBC 报道，英特尔此前主要在自家工厂制造自身产品，正争取为其他芯片设计公司提供代工。陈立武没有公布这家新客户的名称。

他还确认，微软成为英特尔先进封装技术 EMIB 首个公开具名的客户。先进封装负责将不同芯片组合并互连，与芯片晶圆的制造分属不同环节。
title_en: Intel Secures First External Customer for 18A-P Process Node
content_en:
Intel has signed its first external customer for its 18A-P advanced manufacturing process, marking a key milestone in its strategy to build a thriving foundry business for third-party chip designers. Speaking at the TomorrowX summit in Austin, Texas, Intel CEO Lip-Bu Tan initially announced the deal for the 18A node, which technical lead Pushkar Ranade later clarified to be the enhanced 18A-P process. The node entered risk production in June, though Intel has kept the customer's identity undisclosed.

In addition to the foundry progress, Intel confirmed that Microsoft has become the first publicly named customer for its EMIB (Embedded Multi-die Interconnect Bridge) advanced packaging technology. Advanced packaging connects and combines multiple chiplets, operating as a distinct and critical phase alongside traditional wafer fabrication.

title_zh: 联想季度营收首超 300 亿美元，经调整净利润增长 166%
content_zh:
联想集团 11 月 19 日公布截至 9 月 30 日的 2026/27 财年第二季度业绩，营收为 302.38 亿美元，同比增长 48%。按香港财务报告准则（HKFRS），归母净亏损为 6.40 亿美元，主要受到认股权证相关衍生金融负债 19.06 亿美元的非现金公允价值损失影响；剔除相关非现金项目后，经调整归母净利润为 13.61 亿美元，同比增长 166%，经调整净利率为 4.5%。

AI 相关业务收入同比增长 79%，占总营收的 36%。三大业务集团均创下历年第二财季营收新高：

当季经营现金流为 16 亿美元，自由现金流为 12 亿美元。
title_en: Lenovo Quarterly Revenue Surpasses $30 Billion for the First Time as Adjusted Net Profit Soars 166%
content_en:
Lenovo Group reported record-breaking financial results for its second fiscal quarter ending September 30, with revenue topping $30 billion for the first time. Total revenue surged 48% year-over-year to $30.24 billion, supported by all three of its main business groups achieving record second-quarter revenues.

Under HKFRS accounting standards, Lenovo reported a net loss of $640 million due to a $1.91 billion non-cash fair value loss on warrant-related derivative financial liabilities. Excluding these non-cash items, adjusted net profit jumped 166% year-over-year to $1.36 billion, achieving an adjusted net profit margin of 4.5%.

AI-related revenue served as a major growth engine, soaring 79% year-over-year to account for 36% of total revenue. Lenovo also maintained strong operational liquidity, generating $1.6 billion in operating cash flow and $1.2 billion in free cash flow during the quarter.

title_zh: 💡 马斯克：英伟达让黄仁勋离开，如同公牛踢走乔丹
content_zh:
马斯克在《纽约时报》DealBook 峰会上再次支持黄仁勋。他把英伟达让黄仁勋离开的决定，比作芝加哥公牛队在连胜途中将巅峰期的迈克尔·乔丹踢出球队，认为董事会作出这类决定前应当慎重考虑。

据 CNBC 现场报道，马斯克通过远程连线参会，称黄仁勋是「历史上最有才华的企业家之一」，并表示「没有人能真正取代黄仁勋」。他给出的理由是，黄仁勋在英伟达获得了很强的忠诚，尤其是一些抢手的工程师，正是为了与他共事才留在公司。

马斯克还强调了黄仁勋数十年来积累的长期合作关系、对技术的深刻理解，以及团队成员对他的认可。他认为，黄仁勋的离开对公司股东而言并非好事，也不赞成把他视作能够轻易被替换的管理者。

马斯克还表示，黄仁勋虽然「犯了一些错误」，但他不认为黄仁勋对美国不忠。这些表态回应了峰会上关于英伟达是否应该让黄仁勋重返 CEO 岗位的提问。
title_en: Elon Musk Compares Removing Jensen Huang from Nvidia to Chicago Bulls Cutting Michael Jordan
content_en:
Speaking remotely at The New York Times DealBook Summit, Elon Musk voiced strong support for Jensen Huang, comparing any potential move by Nvidia to part ways with its CEO to the Chicago Bulls cutting Michael Jordan during his prime. Musk warned that Nvidia's board should think carefully before considering such a decision.

Describing Huang as "one of the most talented entrepreneurs in history," Musk argued that Huang is virtually irreplaceable. He pointed out that Huang commands immense loyalty within the company, noting that top-tier engineers remain at Nvidia specifically to work alongside him. Musk also highlighted Huang's decades of industry relationships, technical expertise, and respect among his team.

Addressing questions about Huang's leadership and position, Musk stated that while Huang may have made mistakes, he does not doubt his loyalty to the United States. He emphasized that removing Huang would ultimately be a major disservice to Nvidia's shareholders.

title_zh: 华为官宣 Mate 90 Air 与 WATCH Air，主打轻薄设计
content_zh: 华为终端 11 月 19 日接连公布 Mate 90 Air 手机和 WATCH Air 智能手表，两款新品都将于 11 月 24 日 14:30 举行的 HUAWEI Mate X8 及全场景新品发布会上亮相。
title_en: Huawei Teases Ultra-Slim Mate 90 Air and WATCH Air Ahead of November 24 Launch
content_en:
Huawei Consumer BG has officially teased two new additions to its product lineup: the Mate 90 Air smartphone and the WATCH Air smartwatch, both highlighting an ultra-slim design philosophy.

Both devices are scheduled to make their official debut at the HUAWEI Mate X8 & All-Scenario Product Launch Event on November 24 at 14:30.

title_zh: 苹果被曝考虑推迟或取消 OLED iMac，面板成本成阻力
content_zh:
据韩国媒体 The Elec 11 月 19 日报道，苹果正与三星显示讨论调整 OLED iMac 的开发计划，选项包括推迟原定进度，或暂停项目。一名行业人士称，目前讨论主要围绕延后时间表、观察市场状况展开。

报道将成本列为主要原因：iMac 销量低于手机和笔记本，更贵的 OLED 面板会增加整机定价压力；采用 OLED 的 iPad Pro 销售弱于预期，以及内存价格上涨，也影响苹果扩大 OLED 产品线的评估。

此前的 OLED iMac 目标上市时间为 2029 至 2030 年。报道同时称，苹果近期向包括京东方在内的 LCD 供应商发出信息征询，要求开发约 2029 年推出的新 iMac 面板。
title_en: High Panel Costs May Push Apple to Delay or Scrap OLED iMac
content_en:
Apple is reportedly reconsidering its plans for an OLED iMac due to high panel costs and uncertain market demand. According to *The Elec*, Apple is currently in talks with Samsung Display to either delay the project's original 2029–2030 launch window or pause it entirely.

High manufacturing expenses remain the primary hurdle. Given that desktop iMacs sell in lower volumes than smartphones or laptops, adopting expensive OLED panels would place significant upward pressure on retail pricing. Soft sales of the OLED iPad Pro alongside rising memory costs have further cautioned Apple against expanding its OLED desktop lineup.

In the meantime, Apple has reportedly issued requests for information to LCD suppliers, including BOE, to develop new LCD panels for an upcoming iMac revision expected around 2029.

title_zh: Meta Muse Charm 被曝定价 300 美元，附送最长一年 5G 服务
content_zh:
据 The Information 11 月 19 日援引知情人士报道，Meta 计划将便携 AI 设备 Muse Charm 定价为 300 美元，并提供最长 12 个月的 Verizon 免费 5G 数据服务。

扎克伯格已在 9 月的 Connect 大会上展示这款带屏幕、外形类似钥匙挂件的设备，并表示将于冬季假期前后开放订购。它可以访问 Muse 个人 AI 助手，提供实时语音和虚拟形象交互；用户通过指纹传感器触碰设备即可开始对话，无需解锁手机、打开应用。

报道还称，Meta 为优先推进 Muse Charm，将智能手表更大范围的发布推迟到 2027 年，并复用了部分手表研发成果。Meta 对价格和新计划的回应是，将很快分享更多信息。
title_en: Meta's $300 AI Device 'Muse Charm' Reportedly Includes 1 Year of Free 5G Data
content_en:
Meta is planning to price its upcoming portable AI device, the "Muse Charm," at $300, according to *The Information*. The device will reportedly come bundled with up to 12 months of free Verizon 5G data service.

First previewed by Mark Zuckerberg at Meta Connect in September, the screen-equipped, key fob-style device offers direct access to the Muse personal AI assistant for real-time voice and avatar interactions. Users can initiate conversations instantly via an onboard fingerprint sensor without unlocking a smartphone or opening an application. Pre-orders are expected around the winter holiday season.

To prioritize the Muse Charm, Meta has reportedly postponed the broader release of its smartwatch to 2027, repurposing some of its smartwatch R&D into this new hardware. Meta noted that it will share more official information soon.

title_zh: 方程豹钛 9 上市，顶配可将方向盘折叠收起
content_zh:
方程豹钛 9 于 11 月 19 日上市，定位大六座 SUV，推出四驱 Max、四驱 Ultra 和折叠智舱三个版本，售价分别为 27.99 万元、29.99 万元和 32.99 万元。

据车东西报道，折叠智舱版通过线控技术，让方向盘以最高 180° 的角度收起，收纳过程在 10 秒内完成，折叠后与仪表台齐平，释放约 25 厘米腿部空间。主驾座椅最大可躺至 165°，车辆离车泊入、泊出时可同步收起或展开方向盘。

钛 9 首搭比亚迪 DMS 超级混动平台，采用 1.5T 发动机与前后双电机，电机总功率为 400kW，零百加速为 4.8 秒。车辆配备第二代刀片电池、后轮转向及云辇-A 车身控制系统；全系标配带激光雷达的天神之眼 B 辅助驾驶。
title_en: BYD's Fangchengbao Launches Tai 9 SUV Featuring Fold-Away Steering Wheel
content_en:
BYD's Fangchengbao brand officially launched the Tai 9 on November 19. The large six-seater SUV is available in three trims—4WD Max, 4WD Ultra, and the range-topping Folding Smart Cabin edition—priced between 279,900 RMB and 329,900 RMB.

The flagship Folding Smart Cabin variant utilizes steer-by-wire technology to fold the steering wheel up to 180 degrees flush into the dashboard within 10 seconds, freeing up 25 cm of legroom. Complemented by a driver's seat that reclines up to 165 degrees, the steering wheel can automatically retract or deploy during remote auto-parking.

Debut-hosting BYD's new DMS Super Hybrid platform, the Tai 9 combines a 1.5T engine with dual electric motors delivering 400 kW of total power, propelling the vehicle from 0 to 100 km/h in 4.8 seconds. Standard features across all trims include second-generation Blade batteries, rear-wheel steering, DiSus-A body control, and the LiDAR-equipped DiPilot B driver-assist suite.

title_zh: 全新零跑 Lafa5 开启预售，升级 800V 平台与快充
content_zh:
据网通社报道，全新零跑 Lafa5 于 11 月 19 日下午开启预售，预售价 10.58 万元起，计划在 11 月 27 日广州车展正式上市。

本次升级包括全域 800V 平台和 3C 快充，电池容量 69.7kWh，CLTC 纯电续航为 640km，电量从 30% 充至 80% 需 16 分钟。车辆配备激光雷达和高通 8650 芯片，搭载 28 个智能感知硬件。

动力系统最大功率 185kW，零百加速时间为 6.06 秒；底盘标配 FSD 可变阻尼减振，前后轴荷比为 50：50。公布的配置升级项目还包括 50 英寸 AR-HUD、前排双零重力座椅、14 扬声器和 17.3 英寸中控屏。
title_en: Leapmotor Opens Pre-Sales for Upgraded Lafa5 EV with 800V Fast-Charging Platform
content_en:
Leapmotor kicked off pre-sales for the all-new Lafa5 on November 19, starting at 105,800 RMB. The electric vehicle is scheduled to officially launch on November 27 at the Guangzhou Auto Show.

Built on an upgraded full-domain 800V high-voltage platform with 3C fast charging, the Lafa5 packs a 69.7 kWh battery delivering a CLTC range of 640 km. It can replenish its charge from 30% to 80% in just 16 minutes. Tech features include 28 perception sensors, LiDAR support, and Qualcomm's Snapdragon 8650 processing chip.

The powertrain delivers 185 kW of maximum power, achieving 0-100 km/h acceleration in 6.06 seconds. Built with a balanced 50:50 front-to-rear weight distribution, the chassis includes FSD frequency-selective damping. Premium cabin upgrades showcase a 50-inch AR-HUD, dual zero-gravity front seats, a 14-speaker sound system, and a 17.3-inch central touchscreen.

title_zh: Switch 2 可用内置麦克风唱卡拉 OK，JOYSOUND 免费更新
content_zh:
任天堂 11 月 19 日为《卡拉 OK JOYSOUND for Nintendo Switch》推出面向 Switch 2 的免费更新。玩家可以直接用主机内置麦克风唱歌和评分，无需另购麦克风。

更新也支持 Switch 2 摄像头及其他 USB 摄像头，把玩家的画面放进游戏；鼓掌、挥手等动作可触发特效。Joy-Con 2 则新增鼠标选歌，以及用振动播放旋律引导的功能，软件还加入了 Mii 角色在客厅休息的背景。

这款软件可免费下载，购买时段券后可点唱超过 19 万首歌曲，需要联网，但不要求订阅 Nintendo Switch Online。任天堂每月还会开放部分歌曲限时免费演唱。
title_en: Nintendo Updates Karaoke JOYSOUND for Switch 2 with Built-In Mic and Motion Controls
content_en:
Nintendo released a free update for *Karaoke JOYSOUND for Nintendo Switch* tailored for the Switch 2 on November 19. The update enables players to sing and receive real-time scoring using the console's built-in microphone, eliminating the need for a separate hardware accessory.

The update adds support for the Switch 2 camera and external USB webcams, allowing players to view themselves on screen while performing physical actions like clapping or waving to trigger in-game visual effects. Joy-Con 2 controllers now feature mouse-style navigation for song selection and haptic vibration feedback for pitch assistance.

While the application is free to download and requires an internet connection, a Nintendo Switch Online subscription is not required. Players can purchase timed passes to access over 190,000 songs, alongside a selection of free rotating tracks offered monthly.

title_zh: 哈曼卡顿发布 Allure 2，透明穹顶里加入随乐灯光
content_zh:
哈曼卡顿在日本推出 Allure 2 家用蓝牙音箱，将于 11 月 26 日发售，官方直销价格为含税 34,100 日元。

新品采用透明穹顶与织物包覆机身，内置三个 38mm 全频单元及一个向下发声的 89mm 低音单元，总输出功率为 60W。声音向四周扩散，穹顶内的氛围灯可随音乐变化。

用户可通过 Harman Kardon One 应用调整均衡器、灯光颜色、亮度和动态效果，也可将两台音箱组成双声道系统，或使用 Auracast 连接更多兼容音箱。机身尺寸约为 166×203×166mm，重约 2.2kg。
title_en: Harman Kardon Launches Allure 2 Speaker Featuring Music-Synced Lighting
content_en:
Harman Kardon has introduced the Allure 2 home Bluetooth speaker in Japan, set for release on November 26 for 34,100 yen (tax included).

The speaker retains the brand's iconic design language, combining a transparent dome with a fabric-wrapped body. Inside the dome, integrated ambient lighting dynamically shifts in sync with the music.

Delivering 360-degree sound, the Allure 2 features a total output of 60W powered by three 38mm full-range drivers and a downward-firing 89mm subwoofer. Users can customize EQ settings, light colors, brightness, and dynamic effects via the Harman Kardon One app. The speaker also supports dual-channel stereo pairing and Auracast technology to connect multiple compatible speakers.

title_zh: Gemini 推出 Computer Use，可在 Mac 后台操作应用
content_zh:
Google 11 月 19 日为 Mac 版 Gemini 推出电脑操作功能。用户描述任务后，Gemini 可以跨本地文件、桌面应用和网页点击、输入、操作菜单及填写表单。

它在独立的后台窗口里工作，聊天中会显示实时预览，主屏幕和鼠标仍可供用户使用。用户可以选择允许访问的应用、查看执行过程、随时暂停，并在关键动作执行前确认。

Google 展示的用途包括批量调整照片色彩、搭建 3D 场景、从本地 PDF 提取信息填写运费报价，以及从多个地区的仪表盘收集数据制作演示文稿。

该功能首批以英语在美国开放，面向年满 18 岁、使用个人账号的 Google AI Plus、Pro 和 Ultra 用户，设备须为搭载 Apple 芯片、运行 macOS Sequoia 15.0 或更新系统的 Mac。
title_en: Google Introduces 'Computer Use' for Gemini on Mac
content_en:
Google has rolled out a new "Computer Use" feature for Gemini on Mac, allowing the AI assistant to execute desktop tasks based on simple user prompts. Gemini can navigate local files, desktop applications, and web pages to click, type, open menus, and fill out forms.

The system operates in an isolated background window while displaying a real-time preview inside the chat interface, leaving the user's primary screen and controls available. Built-in safety mechanisms allow users to grant specific app permissions, monitor task execution, pause operations at any time, and manually approve critical actions.

The feature is initially available in English for U.S. users aged 18 and above with personal Google AI Plus, Pro, or Ultra subscriptions, running macOS Sequoia 15.0 or later on Apple Silicon Macs.

title_zh: 商汤 SenseNova U1 Pro 进入 Design Arena 图片双榜全球第六
content_zh:
商汤公布，日日新 SenseNova U1 Pro 在 Design Arena 11 月 18 日更新的图片生成、图片编辑两项榜单中均位列全球第六，为两榜排名最高的中国模型；排在其前面的是 OpenAI 的 GPT Image 2.x 系列不同版本。

Design Arena 采用同题生成、匿名两两对比及用户投票，再以 Elo 评分形成动态排名。平台评价称，SenseNova U1 Pro 在指定艺术风格、特定时代美术风格的图片生成任务中表现较强；图片编辑方面，优势是按要求进行局部修改，同时减少其他区域的非预期变化。

商汤介绍，该模型还支持围绕论文、商品图片或创意需求，连续完成信息提取、素材处理、海报与详情页设计，并在生成后进行自检和修正。用户可通过商汤小浣熊体验。
title_en: SenseTime’s SenseNova U1 Pro Ranks Sixth Globally on Design Arena Benchmarks
content_en:
SenseTime announced that its SenseNova U1 Pro model achieved sixth place globally on both the image generation and image editing leaderboards of Design Arena in its November 18 update. This makes it the highest-ranked Chinese model on both charts, trailing only OpenAI’s GPT Image 2.x series.

Design Arena evaluates models using Elo ratings based on blind, head-to-head user voting. The platform commended SenseNova U1 Pro for its strong rendering of specific artistic and historical styles, as well as its precise localized editing capabilities that minimize unintended alterations to surrounding areas.

SenseTime noted that the model supports automated end-to-end design workflows—ranging from extracting key information from research papers or product images to generating and self-correcting promotional posters and detail pages. The model is currently accessible through SenseTime's Raccoon platform.

title_zh: Hyper3D 上线 Low-Poly，可将高精模型转换为低面数网格
content_zh:
Hyper3D 11 月 19 日上线智能低模功能 Low-Poly，并开放 API。创作者可用文字、图片直接生成低面数模型，也能上传自己的高精模型，或使用已有 Rodin 资产进行重拓扑。

这项功能面向实时渲染和后续动画制作：先减少模型面数，同时约束低模贴合原始高模的轮廓与空间位置，再通过法线烘焙把高模细节转移到低模表面。团队称，其可在秒级处理千万面高模，通过 API 最快 15 秒生成带贴图的低面数模型。

Low-Poly 支持在 200～10000 面之间调节，也可自动确定目标面数；提供四边面、三角面和多边面三种拓扑模式。对角色模型，系统会沿关节、腰部和腿部等变形区域生成闭合环线，配合 Hyper3D Rigging 进行骨骼绑定。模型可导出为 GLB、USDZ、FBX、OBJ 和 STL 格式，继续进入编辑、动画及应用流程。
title_en: Hyper3D Launches Low-Poly Tool to Convert High-Res 3D Models into Optimized Meshes
content_en:
Hyper3D has released its new "Low-Poly" feature alongside a dedicated API, enabling creators to generate low-polygon 3D models from text or image prompts, re-topologize existing Rodin assets, or convert high-resolution models into optimized meshes.

Designed for real-time rendering and animation pipelines, the tool reduces polygon counts while preserving spatial positioning and silhouette integrity, transferring detailed high-poly features onto low-poly surfaces via normal baking. The engine handles high-resolution models with tens of millions of polygons in seconds, producing textured low-poly assets in as fast as 15 seconds via the API.

Users can adjust polygon counts between 200 and 10,000 faces—or rely on automatic optimization—and choose from quad, triangle, or n-gon topology modes. For character models, the system generates closed edge loops around joints and key deformation areas to streamline rigging. Assets can be exported in GLB, USDZ, FBX, OBJ, and STL formats.

title_zh: 豆包实时音视频模型开放 API，可边看边听并主动接话
content_zh:
火山引擎 11 月 19 日上线豆包实时音视频通话模型 SeedRealtime 1.0 的 API 服务，开发者可将实时多模态交互能力接入应用。

据火山引擎介绍，模型把声音、画面、时序与表达统一到一个端到端模型中，在连续信息流上交互，减少语音识别、视觉理解和语音合成等多个模块串联带来的延迟与信息损耗。它可持续理解场景变化，在合适时机主动开口。

火山引擎称，相比级联模型，SeedRealtime 1.0 的音视频对话节奏问题减少了一半，可用于语音助手、智能硬件、陪伴式应用和实时客服等场景。
title_en: Volcano Engine Opens API for Doubao's Real-Time Multimodal AI Model
content_en:
Volcano Engine has officially launched API access for SeedRealtime 1.0, the real-time audio-video model powering ByteDance's Doubao AI. The API allows developers to integrate interactive multimodal capabilities directly into their applications.

Built as an end-to-end model, SeedRealtime 1.0 unifies audio, visual input, timing, and vocal expression into a continuous stream. This architecture significantly reduces latency and information loss compared to traditional multi-stage pipelines that chain separate speech recognition, visual understanding, and text-to-speech modules. The model continuously analyzes scene dynamics and can proactively initiate conversation when appropriate.

According to Volcano Engine, SeedRealtime 1.0 cuts conversational pacing issues in half compared to cascaded systems, making it suitable for voice assistants, smart hardware, companion apps, and real-time customer support.

title_zh: Canva 加入生成式 AI 关闭开关，免费用户也能使用
content_zh:
Canva 于 11 月 19 日上线两项 AI 控制选项：用户可以关闭生成式 AI 功能，也可以减少素材库中 AI 生成内容的展示。Canva Free 与 Canva Pro 用户均可免费使用。

生成式 AI 开关位于个人资料的「设置—权限」中。关闭后，相关功能会在 Canva 内隐藏，用户可随时重新开启。另一项选项位于「你的账户—AI 个性化」中，开启后会减少搜索结果和推荐里的 AI 素材，优先呈现设计师及插画师创作的内容，已有设计不受影响。

背景移除和 Magic Grab 等辅助编辑工具继续保留。Canva 解释，这些工具处理现有内容，不生成新内容；单独使用它们，也不会使作品被加上 AI 生成的元数据标签。
title_en: Canva Introduces Toggles to Disable Generative AI and Filter AI Assets
content_en:
Canva has rolled out two new AI control options available to both Free and Pro users, allowing creators to opt out of generative AI features and reduce AI-generated content in their search feeds.

Users can turn off generative AI capabilities under "Settings > Permissions" to hide relevant tools across the platform. Additionally, a new setting under "Account > AI Personalization" reduces AI-generated stock assets in search results and recommendations, prioritizing content created by human designers and illustrators.

Utility editing tools such as Background Remover and Magic Grab remain unaffected. Canva noted that because these features edit existing elements rather than generating new content, using them will not trigger AI-generated metadata tags on user projects.

title_zh: 马斯克计划推出六至七座无人驾驶版 Model Y
content_zh:
据财联社报道，马斯克在 2026 年 DealBook 峰会上表示，特斯拉计划推出可供六至七人出行的无人驾驶版 Model Y。

他将这一计划与单个家庭多人同行的需求联系起来，称车辆将不设方向盘和踏板。马斯克同时表示，特斯拉不会放弃面向普通消费者的汽车业务。
title_en: Musk Announces Fully Driverless 6-to-7 Seater Model Y Without Steering Wheel or Pedals
content_en:
At the DealBook Summit, Elon Musk announced that Tesla plans to launch a fully autonomous, 6- to 7-seater version of the Model Y designed to accommodate family travel.

According to Musk, the upcoming vehicle will feature no steering wheel or pedals. He also reassured stakeholders that Tesla remains committed to its consumer automotive business and will not abandon mainstream vehicles.

title_zh: PHP 8.6 正式发布，旧版本同步获得安全更新
content_zh:
PHP 团队于 11 月 19 日发布 PHP 8.6.0 正式版，加入部分函数应用、只读属性默认值、用于监测流的 Io\Poll API，以及 clamp() 函数、Time\Duration 类和 SortDirection 枚举等新功能。

同日，PHP 8.5、8.4、8.3 和 8.2 分支分别更新至 8.5.13、8.4.28、8.3.37 和 8.2.36，官方均将其列为安全版本，并建议对应分支用户升级。

PHP 安全团队在前一日预告中表示，这轮更新修复影响所有受支持版本的漏洞，其中最高等级为严重，但严重等级的问题需要非默认配置或不常见的部署环境才会触发。各版本源码及 Windows 构建已在官方下载渠道提供。
title_en: PHP 8.6 Officially Released Alongside Critical Security Updates for Older Branches
content_en:
The PHP development team officially released PHP 8.6.0 on November 19, introducing several major features including partial function application, default values for readonly properties, the `Io\Poll` API for stream monitoring, a native `clamp()` function, a `Time\Duration` class, and a `SortDirection` enum.

Simultaneously, security maintenance updates were rolled out across older supported branches—updating PHP 8.5, 8.4, 8.3, and 8.2 to versions 8.5.13, 8.4.28, 8.3.37, and 8.2.36, respectively. The development team urges users on all branches to upgrade promptly.

According to the PHP Security Team, these releases patch vulnerabilities affecting all supported versions, including a critical-severity bug that requires non-default configurations or rare deployment environments to exploit. Source code and Windows builds are now available through official distribution channels.

title_zh: 曝影石 Luna 云台相机拟于 12 月涨价约 300 元
content_zh:
据《科创板日报》报道，上海多家影石 Insta360 门店传出 Luna 系列云台相机拟提价的消息。

有店员称，近期收到的通知要求 Luna 自 12 月 15 日起涨价约 300 元，原因是存储成本上升。其他系列暂未收到涨价通知。该消息来自门店走访，影石官方尚未公开回应。
title_en: Insta360 Luna Gimbal Camera Set for Price Hike in December Due to Rising Component Costs
content_en:
Insta360 is reportedly planning a price increase for its Luna gimbal camera series starting December 15, according to store visits by *Star Market Daily* across several Shanghai retail outlets.

Store staff revealed they received notices indicating that Luna series prices will rise by approximately 300 RMB, citing increased storage component costs. Other product lines currently remain unaffected.

Insta360 has not yet issued an official public statement regarding the reported price adjustment.

title_zh: Airbnb 在孟买复刻《有时快乐有时悲伤》豪宅，限量开放参观
content_zh:
Airbnb 为印度电影《有时快乐有时悲伤》（Kabhi Khushi Kabhie Gham）上映 25 周年，在孟买复刻片中的 Raichand 家族豪宅，将于 12 月 1 日至 6 日开放两小时沉浸式体验，共提供 180 个名额。

参观者可进入标志性的楼梯、家族书房及角色 Poo 的衣帽间，通过音频导览重温电影场景，并参与角色主题挑战、书写与影片家庭主题相关的留言。每位访客还将获赠纪念品。

这部 2001 年电影由卡伦·乔哈尔执导，沙鲁克·汗、卡卓儿、阿米塔布·巴强等主演，围绕富裕家庭因儿子的婚姻选择而产生的矛盾展开。此次体验由导演及原片演员赫里尼克·罗斯汉、卡琳娜·卡普共同呈现，三人不会到场。

预约申请将于 11 月 23 日印度时间中午 12 点开放。活动免费，每次预约可供两人参与，前往孟买的交通需自行安排。
title_en: Airbnb Recreates Iconic 'Kabhi Khushi Kabhie Gham' Mansion in Mumbai for Exclusive Fan Experience
content_en:
To celebrate the legacy of the classic 2001 Bollywood blockbuster *Kabhi Khushi Kabhie Gham*, Airbnb has recreated the iconic Raichand family mansion in Mumbai. The company is offering a limited-edition, immersive two-hour tour for just 180 fans from December 1 to 6.

Visitors will get to explore set recreations including the grand staircase, the family study, and Poo’s famed walk-in closet. Guided by audio narrations, guests can participate in character-themed challenges, write personal messages about family ties, and take home exclusive memorabilia.

Presented in collaboration with director Karan Johar and stars Hrithik Roshan and Kareena Kapoor (who will not appear in person), the experience is completely free. Bookings open on November 23 at 12:00 PM IST for pairs of guests, though travelers must arrange their own transportation to Mumbai.

title_zh: Nimble 把定位器做进钱包和行李牌，支持苹果与 Google 查找网络
content_zh:
据 TechCrunch 报道，配件品牌 Nimble 于 11 月 19 日推出 Trace 系列，将定位功能直接整合进钱包、钥匙扣、行李牌和护照夹，七款产品均兼容苹果「查找」和 Google Find Hub 网络。

该系列已在品牌官网及亚马逊开售，入门款 Trace Tag 售价为 14.95 美元，使用可更换的纽扣电池；带有内置充电定位功能的护照夹 Trace Folio 售价为 49.95 美元。部分型号支持 USB-C 或无线充电，钥匙扣 Trace Keyfob 标称充一次电可使用约六个月。

Nimble 称，系列采用再生塑料及芦荟基植物皮革等材料，并提供黑、石色、橘色、李子色和青色五种配色。公司 CEO Ross Howe 在采访中表示，团队希望让人们直接找到钱包等物品，而不必再往里面塞一枚单独的定位器。
title_en: Nimble Launches 'Trace' Line of Eco-Friendly Everyday Gear with Built-in Apple and Google Tracking
content_en:
Accessory brand Nimble has unveiled its new "Trace" lineup, embedding smart location-tracking directly into everyday essentials like wallets, keychains, luggage tags, and passport holders. The seven-piece collection is compatible with both Apple’s Find My and Google’s Find My Device networks.

Available now on Nimble's website and Amazon, the line ranges from the entry-level $14.95 Trace Tag (powered by a replaceable coin battery) to the $49.95 Trace Folio passport holder with built-in rechargeable tracking. Select models support USB-C or wireless charging, with the Trace Keyfob boasting a battery life of up to six months per charge.

Crafted from sustainable materials—including recycled plastics and aloe-based plant leather—the series comes in five distinct colors. Nimble CEO Ross Howe noted that the goal was to create seamless items that eliminate the hassle of slipping bulky, standalone trackers into everyday carry items.

title_zh: Meta Quest 上线逾 150 部 3D 电影，碧梨演唱会电影限时独家
content_zh:
据 Variety 报道，Meta 11 月 19 日在 Quest 的 TV 应用中上线超过 150 部可租借或购买的 3D 电影，首批向美国的 Quest 3、Quest 3S 用户开放。

片库包括《死侍与金刚狼》《阿凡达》《蜘蛛侠：英雄远征》等。碧梨与詹姆斯·卡梅隆共同执导的演唱会电影《Hit Me Hard and Soft: The Tour》，其 3D 租售版本将由 Meta Quest 独家提供至 12 月 31 日。

多数影片购买价为 16.99 美元、租借价为 6.99 美元，具体价格因影片而异。Meta 表示，随着明年春季 Meta VR Glasses 推出，片库将扩展至数千部，并向更多地区开放。

最新 Quest 软件还提供「影院」模式，在显示大银幕的同时调暗周围环境。
title_en: Meta Quest Rolls Out 150+ 3D Movies Featuring Exclusive Billie Eilish Concert Film
content_en:
Meta has launched a catalog of over 150 3D movies available for rent or purchase via the Meta Quest TV app. Rolling out initially to Quest 3 and Quest 3S users in the United States, the library features major blockbusters such as *Deadpool & Wolverine*, *Avatar*, and *Spider-Man: Far From Home*.

As a marquee addition, Meta Quest holds exclusive 3D rental and purchase rights through December 31 for Billie Eilish’s concert film, *Hit Me Hard and Soft: The Tour*, co-directed by James Cameron. Most titles are priced at $6.99 for rental and $16.99 for purchase.

Meta plans to expand the library to thousands of titles and broaden availability globally alongside the release of Meta VR Glasses next spring. Additionally, a new software update introduces a dedicated "Theater" mode, which dims ambient VR surroundings to enhance the big-screen viewing experience.

title_zh: 《无敌少侠》第五季定档明年 2 月，汉堡店主题预告公开
content_zh:
据 Variety 报道，Prime Video 宣布《无敌少侠》第五季将于 2027 年 2 月 17 日上线，并公开一支以剧中快餐店 Burger Mart 为主题的先导预告。

新一季承接第四季的重大事件：马克试图找到让世界变得更好的办法，即使这可能让他失去珍视的人际关系、朋友和盟友。他必须决定自己要成为什么样的英雄，以及为拯救地球愿意付出多少代价。

《无敌少侠》改编自罗伯特·柯克曼、科里·沃克等人的漫画，由 Skybound Animation 制作，史蒂文·元、吴珊卓和 J.K. 西蒙斯等参与配音。亚马逊称，第四季是该剧迄今观看人数最多的一季。
title_en: 'Invincible' Season 5 Sets February 2027 Premiere with Burger Mart Teaser
content_en:
Prime Video has officially announced that *Invincible* Season 5 will premiere on February 17, 2027. Alongside the release date announcement, the platform debuted a teaser trailer themed around Burger Mart, the fast-food chain featured in the series.

The upcoming season picks up in the aftermath of Season 4's dramatic events. As Mark searches for ways to make the world better, he risks alienating the relationships, friends, and allies he treasures most. He must ultimately decide what kind of hero he wants to be and how much he is willing to sacrifice to save the planet.

Adapted from the comic book series by Robert Kirkman and Cory Walker, the show is produced by Skybound Animation and features a voice cast led by Steven Yeun, Sandra Oh, and J.K. Simmons. Amazon noted that Season 4 was the series' most-watched season to date.

title_zh: 《豺狼的日子》第二季首支预告公开，明年 3 月回归
content_zh:
Sky 与 Peacock 公开《豺狼的日子》第二季首支预告，Eddie Redmayne 饰演的职业杀手「豺狼」再度出现。剧集将于 2027 年 3 月回归。

据 Deadline 报道，Úrsula Corberó、Charles Dance 等演员继续出演，Matt Bomer、Pablo Schreiber、Weruche Opia 和 Pia Tjelta 加入新一季。第二季由 David Harrower 担任首席编剧、Brian Kirk 担任首席导演，已在匈牙利、克罗地亚、西班牙、比利时、奥地利和英国拍摄。

这部剧集改编自 Frederick Forsyth 的同名小说及 1973 年电影版。第一季首集在英国累计触达 700 万观众，并成为 Sky 当时表现最好的新剧首播；NBCUniversal 称，它也成为 Peacock 上线 75 天内观看最多的新原创剧情剧。
title_en: 'The Day of the Jackal' Season 2 Teaser Released Ahead of March 2027 Return
content_en:
Sky and Peacock have unveiled the first teaser trailer for *The Day of the Jackal* Season 2, marking the return of Eddie Redmayne as the elusive assassin "the Jackal." The hit series is scheduled to return in March 2027.

According to *Deadline*, returning cast members including Úrsula Corberó and Charles Dance will be joined by new additions Matt Bomer, Pablo Schreiber, Weruche Opia, and Pia Tjelta. The second season features David Harrower as lead writer and Brian Kirk as lead director, with filming taking place across Hungary, Croatia, Spain, Belgium, Austria, and the UK.

Based on Frederick Forsyth's novel and its 1973 film adaptation, the thriller was a breakout hit in its first season. The debut episode reached 7 million viewers in the UK, making it Sky's top-performing new drama launch at the time, while Peacock reported it as its most-watched new original drama series within its first 75 days.
